description:
The **Web API Template** (id = webapi) is packaged under the GUID {12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab}. It is described as “A template for creating a modern Web API project.” (description id = descWebApi) and appears fifth in the New Project dialog (order = 5) with the icon located at icons/webapi.png. Docker support is offered (supportsDocker = true) and can be toggled via the “Add Docker Support” option (symbol id = useDocker, name = Add Docker Support, name id = dockerName, description = Include Docker files for container deployment., description id = dockerDesc). The template also respects a disableHttps symbol for non‑HTTPS ports. By default, symbols are hidden in the IDE (defaultSymbolVisibility = false) and their values are persisted per template group (defaultPersistenceScope = templateGroup) under the namespace MyCompany.Templates (defaultPersistenceScopeName).

Two configurable symbols are defined. The **framework** symbol (id = framework) lets the user choose the target framework; it is visible (isVisible = true), not inverted (invertBoolean = false), and defaults to **net6.0** (defaultValue). Its displayed name is “.NET 6” (name id = frameworkName) with the description “Target framework for the project.” (description id = frameworkDesc). Persistence for this choice is scoped to the template group (persistenceScope = templateGroup) under the name FrameworkScope. The available choices are **net5** (id = net5, name = “.NET 5”, name id = net5Name, description = “Legacy .NET 5 framework.”, description id = net5Desc) and **net6** (id = net6, name = “.NET 6”, name id = net6Name, description = “Current .NET 6 framework.”, description id = net6Desc). The Docker option (useDocker) persists across shared sessions (persistenceScope = shared) under the name DockerScope and defaults to “false”.

The template adds the platform tag web and removes the tag mobile, while also adding the project‑type tag api. It is not available for Visual Studio versions 17.0 through 18.0 (unsupported host vs, version [17.0,18.0)). To appear, the environment must have the setup component Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.Web (component type setupComponent, version 17.2) installed for the vs host.
